previous_rule: R4/R5 recovery packager requires detached git checkout of source commit.

replacement: Use actual provider commit->root tree->subtree->path/mode/blob identities, reused verified archive bytes, and missing-blob API recovery. Verify every archive member against those identities.
scope: Packaging/source recovery only; no source, math, budget, owner or merge policy changes.
authority: Current explicit additive per-stage publication and backup request; physmath-research-loop policy correction.
